title: Projektetage Resize Handles Alignment
description: Fix interactive resize on projektetage: content scales uniformly inside the frame (no text reflow overshoot); resize handles aligned with selection chrome.
summary:
Fixed catalogue split-grid resize handles (Bauteilkatalog / focus slides).

Root cause: canvas-framed CSS forced every `.presentation-figure-tile-frame` to `position: static; width/height 100%`, collapsing the 15-tile grid into one box while chrome stayed on the bounding wrapper — handles looked inside the per-tile highlights and vanished when layout flipped on drag.

- Split dispositions use `--split-group` wrapper at the tile bounding rect; tiles are re-expressed with `splitTilesInGroupFrame` relative to that rect.
- Tile frames keep absolute % placement; only single disposition frames are flattened to fill the wrapper.
- Handles centered on corners via `translate(-50%, -50%)`; chrome stays visible during gestures (`--gesturing`).
- Fullscreen control remains mounted while handles hide in fullscreen.

42 core + 44 renderer tests pass.
